Output one centered, complete emblem on a transparent square canvas, preferably 2048×2048 or larger for later enlargement. Reconstruct only tiny clipped ornament tips if needed to create a complete silhouette, and give the whole object about 5% transparent safe padding on every side. No rectangular panel, no border around the canvas, no white/black/checkerboard background, no baked checkerboard, no broad glow fading across the whole canvas. Crisp antialiased alpha edges suitable for both light and dark live backgrounds. No new text, objects, watermark, browser chrome or mockup.
